description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the embedding layer and the average correct gate rate for different inputs, comparing character attention input, character MLP input, and Wiki MLP input. The x-axis, labeled "Embedding Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 30 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate", also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The plot displays four lines: a solid blue line representing character attention input, a dashed blue line for character MLP input, a solid red line for an unspecified input, and a dashed red line for Wiki MLP input. The solid blue line starts at approximately 0.2 at embedding layer 0, peaks at around 0.8 at layer 5, then declines to about 0.2 at layer 12, before rising to around 0.7 at layer 20 and fluctuating between 0.6 and 0.8 until layer 31. The dashed blue line begins at roughly 0.8 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.5 at layer 12, and then increases to around 0.9 at layer 18, remaining relatively stable until layer 31. The solid red line starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, rises to around 0.8 at layer 5, drops to about 0.3 at layer 12, and then increases to roughly 0.65 at layer 18, before fluctuating between 0.55 and 0.7 until layer 31. The dashed red line begins at around 0.85 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.55 at layer 12, and then rises to approximately 0.9 at layer 18, remaining relatively stable until layer 31. Each line has a shaded region indicating the range of values around it.
